title: Reading a register after replacement
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration, let $s$ be a state, let $r$ be a register, let $f$ assign an optional Boolean symbol to each integer tape cell, and let $p$ be an integer. In the configuration obtained from $c$ by setting the state to $s$, replacing register $r$'s tape by $f$, and placing its head at $p$, the symbol scanned by register $r$ is $f(p)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is an integer-indexed tape of optional Boolean symbols
